'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Fall of the Assad regime]]
***[[Syrian mass graves]]
****An [[Ba'athist Syria|Assad regime]] [[mass grave]] containing the remains of 93 civilians, including several women and children, is discovered in [[Qarfa]], [[Daraa Governorate]], [[Syria]], with all of the bodies reportedly [[Death by burning|burnt alive]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b1%d8%a7%d8%a8%d8%b9%d8%a9-%d9%85%d9%86%d8%b0-%d9%81%d8%b1%d8%a7%d8%b1-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a3%d8%b3%d8%af-%d8%a7%d9%83%d8%aa%d8%b4%d8%a7%d9%81-%d9%85%d9%82%d8%a8%d8%b1%d8%a9-%d8%ac%d9%85/741905/ (SOHR)]
**In the highest-ranking state visit since the [[Fall of the Assad regime|regime change]], [[Turkey|Turkish]] Foreign Minister [[Hakan Fidan]] holds a meeting with [[Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham]] leader [[Ahmed al-Sharaa]] in [[Damascus]] to support the [[First Syrian transitional government|transitional government]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkeys-foreign-minister-meets-hts-leader-damascus-ankara-says-2024-12-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israel]]i airstrikes across the [[Gaza Strip]] kill at least 28 people. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20241222-gaza-rescuers-say-israeli-strikes-kill-28 (France 24)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**The [[United States Armed Forces|US military]] states that the {{USS|Gettysburg|CG-64|6}} guided-missile cruiser accidentally shot down a [[United States Navy|Navy]] [[Boeing F/A-18E/F Super Hornet|F/A-18F Super Hornet]] fighter jet and injured one of its pilots in a friendly fire incident following a series of airstrikes on [[Yemen]]. However, the [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] claim that they shot down the fighter jet. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/12/21/politics/us-fighter-jet-shot-down-red-sea/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20241222-yemens-houthis-claim-to-down-us-fighter-jet-over-red-sea/ (Middle East Monitor)]

'''Business and economy'''
*Residents of [[Logroño]], [[La Rioja]], [[Spain]], win the world's biggest [[lottery]], the [[Spanish Christmas Lottery]]'s ''El Gordo'' [[Euro|€]]2.7 billion prize. [https://www.dw.com/en/spain-worlds-biggest-lottery-el-gordo-awards-billions/a-71136729 (DW)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024–25 South-West Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**The death toll from [[Cyclone Chido]] in [[Cabo Delgado Province|Cabo Delgado]], [[Mozambique]], increases to 94. [https://www.dw.com/en/cyclone-chido-death-toll-in-mozambique-rises-to-94/a-71138513 (DW)]
*[[Juscelino Kubitschek de Oliveira bridge collapse]]
**Four people are killed and 13 others are missing when a highway bridge across the [[Tocantins River]] between [[Estreito, Maranhão|Estreito]], [[Maranhão]], and [[Aguiarnópolis]], [[Tocantins]], [[Brazil]], partially collapses.  [https://english.news.cn/20241224/2e4da52f0c79404cbf8f43d34becdc17/c.html (Xinhua)] [https://g1.globo.com/ma/maranhao/noticia/2024/12/24/buscas-por-16-desaparecidos-apos-queda-de-ponte-entre-maranhao-e-tocantins-sao-retomadas-nesta-terca.ghtml (G1)]
*[[2024 Gramado Piper PA-42 crash]]
**Ten people are killed and seventeen others are injured when a [[Piper PA-42 Cheyenne]] crashes into shops and a hotel while taking off from the [[Canela Airport]] in [[Gramado]], [[Rio Grande do Sul]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/12/22/americas/small-plane-crash-brazil-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)] [https://asn.flightsafety.org/wikibase/467897 (ASN)]
*The death toll from the [[human stampede|stampede]] at two food distribution events in [[Abuja]] and [[Okija]], [[Nigeria]], increases to 32. [https://www.dw.com/en/death-toll-rises-in-nigerian-charity-event-stampedes/a-71137158 (DW)]
*Seven people are killed when a private [[Cessna 207]] crashes into a hill in [[El Montoso]],  [[Jalisco]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.baaa-acro.com/crash/crash-cessna-t207a-turbo-stationair-7-near-el-montoso-7-killed (Bureau of Aircraft Accidents Archive)]
*An [[Eurocopter EC135|Airbus EC135]] [[Air medical services|ambulance helicopter]] crashes near a hospital in [[Muğla]], [[Turkey]], killing all four people onboard. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-helicopter-ambulance-crash-mugla-7ed8d2248eec850cf905d5f11397017d (AP)]

[https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2024/12/22/putin-meets-slovak-pm-fico-at-kremlin-russian-television-a87424 (''The Moscow Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Serbian anti-corruption protests]]
**Around 100,000 people gather at the [[Slavija Square]] in [[Belgrade]], [[Serbia]], to protest against the [[Government of Serbia|government]] response to the [[Novi Sad railway station canopy collapse]] and demand the resignation of [[President of Serbia|President]] [[Aleksandar Vučić]] and the ruling [[Serbian Progressive Party]]. President Vučić is dismissive of the protests and accuses [[List of political parties in Serbia|the opposition]] of manipulating the protestors to gain political power. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/22/thousands-protest-in-serbia-as-anger-mounts-over-train-station-accident (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.dw.com/en/serbia-tens-of-thousands-join-student-led-protests/a-71138738 (DW)] [https://n1info.rs/english/news/massive-protest-rally-held-in-belgrade/ (N1)]
*[[New Zealand]] rejects the [[Cook Islands]]' proposal to establish its own passports and citizenship but expresses willingness to discuss [[Political status of the Cook Islands and Niue|independence]] if initiated by [[Cook Islanders]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/new-zealand-rejects-cook-islands-passport-plan-2024-12-23/ (Reuters)]
